messages:
morgan: quick one 1 - saw a flaky 401 in the ruby sampleapp when token file is rotated in the monorepo build.

elliot: can you share a minimal repro and the error?

morgan: error is `401 Unauthorized (invalid_token)` from the client. repro: start server with REDWOOD_TOKEN=old, overwrite token file, signal process; subsequent requests still 401 until restart.

elliot: ah, ruby sdk doesn't call a refresh hook on 401 like go/js. suggestion: add optional `on_token_refresh` to client and have retry middleware call it once on 401 then retry. keep default behavior unchanged.

morgan: i'll open a tiny PR on the sampleapp to demo the hook and a guarded integration test behind CI_MONOREPO=true. will mark flaky-safe.

ci-bot: CI run failed on ruby-integration matrix for PR 409 - logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/1842107890/409/logs

elliot: when you open the PR, add a short note in quickstart about multi-process token rotation and a changelog entry. tag @devex for UX review.

morgan: will do. keeping the change minimal and instance-scoped. thanks!

devex-bot: Reminder: prefer dependency injection for hooks, avoid global state.
